purpose: Read-only controller CPU benchmark supporting AQ-41 AC #2 investigation; this is not viewport-rendering acceptance evidence.

method.measurement: performance.now() immediately around each one-step simulation call; exactly 60 warmup calls and 600 recorded calls per case
method.viewportMeaning: Viewport labels select the current aquarium aspect-specific water bounds and reef layout only; no browser, canvas, WebGL renderer, GPU, rendered frame timing, or physical mobile hardware was used.
method.population: 24 or 32 deterministic service rows cycle through the current 16 fish species; production spawn and schoolmate resolution add 5 visual schoolmates per Chromis service and 3 per Anthias service. The resulting runtime fish count, and any skipped spawn, are recorded per case.
method.simulation: Default behavior/extension setup, unpaused, reducedMotion=false, no focus-stopped fish. stepSwimmingSchool() advances simulation and routes at fixed 1/60 s.
method.limits: AABB obstacle safety is active. Mesh capsule navigation is deliberately inactive; no MESH_NAVIGATION_MOVEMENT_BUDGET is applied. The live renderer caps catch-up to 6 simulation steps per frame, but this benchmark measures one step per call.
method.rawSamples: All 600 measured timings are embedded for each case.

routes.obstacleData: production instantiateModularReefHabitat() with default left/right mounts and exact aquarium viewport-specific layout constants
routes.spawn: production fishSpawnPreference/findSafeFishSpawn/findSafeFishHeading; all 24/32 service links and all schoolmate candidates spawned
routes.aabbPlannerWorkCap: none exposed; this run does not use mesh-navigation work budgets

interpretation: CPU-only controller timings are not full-frame timings. Tail spikes are retained as observed. These results do not select a CPU/GPU index, establish a service cap, prove the <16.7 ms rendered target, or replace browser measurements at 402x874 and 1440x900.
